presentations.more: `values` produces its elements only when it is consumed, and this function consumes it more than once. Depending on what it is, the second pass throws (a Java stream), sees nothing at all because the first pass used everything up (an iterator or generator), or runs the whole pipeline again (a query or a sequence) — none of which is what the code reads as doing. Collect it into a list once and use the list, or build a fresh sequence for each pass.

specs.description: `Dumbbell.tsx` — Dumbbell. This project's call graph records DIRECT calls only, so a function passed to a container, destructured into an exported binding, or reached through a dynamic lookup is not one it can see. Within that limit it records no call to this module. At least one of its operations is exported. At run time it reaches `scale`, `useNumberFormat` and `useReveal`. `Dumbbell` builds `signed` and `Dumbbell` builds `x`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside them. Observed: “`values` is a lazy sequence and is consumed twice.” 1 requirement: 1 violated.
